messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: dedicated-pool-eu-west-3 p99 latency > SLO (1200ms) for 6m. Auto-scale failed to provision warmup nodes within 3m. PagerDuty: oncall-jordan
oncall-jordan: looking
samanthar: seeing p95 ~ 320ms, p99 ~ 1.6s, lots of streaming stalls in tail. queue depth spiking to 1200 requests on pool 'eu-west-3-hotshot'
kyle-sre: confirmed telemetry: autoscaler entrained, warmup handshake timeouts ~ 15s, new nodes not joining
maria-eng: customer-impact: CS reports streaming timeouts for two customers on dedicated plans, one session drop. CS @customer-success-anna please add details
customer-success-anna: confirmed, CUST-582 has repeated partial responses and stalls, user-facing timeout errors. Escalated to account execs
ishan: stack: warmup worker logs show failure to prefill KV cache due to transient 503 from backend-store. snippet:
```
WARN WarmupPrefill failed: backend-store 503
trace warmup::prefill at kv_prefill.rs:223
```
oncall-jordan: immediate mitigations?
kyle-sre: plan A: manual scale: spin up 4 warm nodes in pool, mark as bypass-warmup so requests route there immediately. Plan B: fallback: route traffic to compatible model variant in hosted pool with slightly lower throughput
samanthar: I can trigger manual spin-up, but need perms. @deploy-bot can you run the spin-up script for pool eu-west-3-hotshot? (dry-run id: DW-1754)
deploy-bot: command queued: spinup --pool eu-west-3-hotshot --count 4 --bypass-warmup=true
maria-eng: also suggest lowering per-req batching limit to reduce queue depth: from 16 -> 8 temporarily
ishan: I'll patch warmup handshake timeout from 5s -> 15s in autoscaler config and redeploy on a hotfix channel
oncall-jordan: doing the handoff to infra: @kyle-sre you're primary for scale ops, @ishan for warmup patch. I'll coordinate customer comms
kyle-sre: started manual spin-up, live log: node-3456 joining, node-3457 joining
samanthar: routing changes applied, sending 40% of traffic to hosted fallback, 60% to dedicated pool
maria-eng: observed queue depth drop to ~600 after routing change, p99 dropped to 900ms
customer-success-anna: told CUST-582 we're routing to fallback to stabilize latency, they noted fewer timeouts
ishan: warmup handshake timeout patch pushed to autoscaler, will monitor
kyle-sre: warm nodes finished prefill, KV cache backfill success: logs show prefill duration ~ 8s
maria-eng: p95 now 310ms, p99 420ms, streaming stalls reduced but still occasional tail spikes
oncall-jordan: next steps: 1) keep fallback routing for 10m 2) monitor for regressions 3) follow-up postmortem assigned to ishan + kyle-sre 4) notify account execs
samanthar: noted, creating incident doc and linking prompt evals to detect quality regressions due to fallback
customer-success-anna: customer asks for RCA ETA, will update once we have postmortem draft
kyle-sre: marking incident as mitigated for paging; keeping thread open for 1h for telemetry
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation actions applied. Alert suppressed. Metrics link: https://metrics/redwood/incidents/1754129876
oncall-jordan: thanks team :thumbsup:
